# portafib-api-interna-client-signature-v1

API Interna de PortaFIB que ofereix serveis associats amb la firma digital

- API version: 1.0-SNAPSHOT

- Generator version: 7.10.0

Conjunt de Serveis REST de PortaFIB per atendre peticions de firma en servidor, firma web síncrona, firma web asíncrona, validació de firma i plantilla de flux de firma.

  For more information, please visit [https://governdigital.fundaciobit.org](https://governdigital.fundaciobit.org)

*Automatically generated by the [OpenAPI Generator](https://openapi-generator.tech)*

1. Java 1.8+
2. Maven/Gradle

## Installation

To install the API client library to your local Maven repository, simply execute:

```shell
mvn clean install
```

To deploy it to a remote Maven repository instead, configure the settings of the repository and execute:

```shell
mvn clean deploy
```

Refer to the [OSSRH Guide](http://central.sonatype.org/pages/ossrh-guide.html) for more information.

### Maven users

Add this dependency to your project's POM:

```xml
<dependency>
  <groupId>es.caib.portafib</groupId>
  <artifactId>portafib-api-interna-client-signature-v1</artifactId>
  <version>1.0-SNAPSHOT</version>
  <scope>compile</scope>

```
